output_text: description: Defines best practices for maintainable, performant, robust Ansible code. Always structure Ansible into roles and collections. Roles: encapsulate specific functionalities; collections group related roles, modules, and plugins. Role Scoping: Each role or module must focus on a single, well-defined task; avoid monolithic roles. Fact Modules: Create dedicated `_info` or `_facts` modules/tasks for gathering information, rather than overloading existing ones. Enforce strict YAML formatting: file start `---`; two spaces indentation, never tabs. Quotes: quote strings only when necessary; prefer single quotes; use double quotes for escaping characters or multi-line strings. Colon spacing: exactly one space after a colon in key-value pairs.
